rows.en:
O-oh, I see...
So how was my singing?
Th-that's harsh, Sheryl-san!

\p!
Hurry up and get ready!!

Sheryl!
What do you mean, get ready...?

For the concert, obviously!
The real thing's about to start!!
Concert? What's that?

Quit playing dumb!
Hurry up and change into your costume!!
H-hey, wait, these are women's clothes!
Of course they are!
O-of course they are? I'm a guy, you know?

Cross-dressing is all the rage these days!
You know that much, don't you!!
I-I don't know anything about that!!
No way, I am absolutely not changing!!
Never mind that, just change already!
N-no violence!!

What a guy. You just won't accept your fate,
will you...
H-hey, wait! Don't try to undress me~!
Hey, quit thrashing around!
Nooo-waaaay!
Huh!!!

Sleeping during a briefing?
You've got some nerve.
Sigh... I'm not bailing you out...

Are you really that happy to be performing
in Sheryl's concert?
rows.notes: The player talked in their sleep. Aligned: raibu 'concert' (Luis's street shows 'gig'), glossary 2026-10-17.

rows.en: Ahahaha... haha...

A hundred laps around the hangar in EX-Gear!!!
Get going, right now!!!

(Waking up from the dream didn't make it
any better~!)

\p-chan!
Hurry up and get ready!!

Sheryl-san!
What do you mean, get ready...?
Concert? What are you talking about?
H-hey, wait, this is Ranka-chan's costume!

O-of course it is?
I'm not Ranka-chan, you know?

You inherited the stage name
"Ranka Lee the Second," didn't you!
rows.notes: Shuumei: kabuki-style name succession (the next row picks up on it).

rows.en:
I-I don't know anything about that!!
And what's with "the Second"...?
Is Ranka-chan a kabuki actor or something??

Nooo, I am absolutely not changing!
A costume this cute won't look good on me!!

(Waking up from the dream didn't make it
any better~!)

...You finally showed up,
\p.
Huh, Sheryl... What's up?
...I've been waiting for you.
*stare*...
Please don't stare at me so obviously...
...Isn't there something you ought to tell me?

Sigh... You're so stubborn...
No, maybe you're just dense...
rows.notes: x8: Sheryl, and also tagged PLAYER/none right after the scene ends (ext_she_005/007), apparently the player echoing her words.

rows.en:
I heard an interesting rumor... That you've been
hanging out with that woman a lot, and leaving
out the great Sheryl-sama!

Playing dumb? You've got some nerve...
Just you wait till next time!?
Got it!?
Ah, yes... Understood...

...You finally showed up,
\p-chan.
Huh? Sheryl-san... What's the matter?
...I've been waiting for you.
(Th-this is so embarrassing...)
Sheryl~!

\p...
What do you want, out here of all places?

What about you, Sheryl? What are you doing,
hanging around in front of Nyan-Nyan?

I-I'm not hanging around!
I was thinking of going in, but I just couldn't
find the right moment...
Then why don't you just go in?

I'm not comfortable walking into a place like this
all by myself!

I'd go in on my own, though~
Want to go in with me, then?
...Now there's an idea!
Come on, let's go!!

Today the great Sheryl-sama is treating you,
so you'd better be grateful, okay?

Huh!
Really!?
I hardly ever do favors like this, you know?
Thank you!

Hey, boss!
Twenty servings of maguro buns, please~
Th-that's way too many, isn't it!?

With Chinese food, it's good manners
to leave a little on the plate.

You sure can put it away.
That makes treating you worth it.

You eat a ton too, Sheryl. You're so skinny,
so where does all that food go...?
For concerts, your body is your capital.
Wow~!

Shall we head home soon...?
Excuse me, could you bring me the check?
...Hmm, that's cheap.
Let's see, my wallet, my wallet...
Oh my...
My wallet's gone...
...Ugh... I left it at the hotel...
I-I don't have that kind of money either!?

...I wonder if they'd let me work
a temporary part-time shift...
You have my gratitude!
rows.notes: Sheryl waiting tables in her own haughty style.

rows.en: So nice of you to come.

uncertain: c03329: x8, tagged Sheryl and also PLAYER/none once per scene (after Sheryl leaves, ext_she_005/007); written as Sheryl's line, which also works as the player echoing her.
c03351: Sheryl's 'Masutaa!' to the Nyan-Nyan shopkeeper rendered 'Hey, boss!'.
c03366/c03367: Sheryl's waitress lines kept in her haughty register ('You have my gratitude!', 'So nice of you to come.').
